title: Step 14: corrected reduced system verification on S^2 x S^2

CORRECTED_base_curvature_formula.formula: K_B = (1/4)(|grad v|^2 - |grad log w|^2) = -<grad log p, grad log q>
CORRECTED_base_curvature_formula.sign: K_B can be positive or negative depending on relative magnitudes
CORRECTED_base_curvature_formula.RETRACTED: The earlier K_B >= 3 was from the WRONG formula Hess(log w) = (K_B-1)g_B; the correct formula has an extra quadratic gradient term.

complete_reduced_system.eq1: -Delta_B w = 2 w,  w=0 on dOmega  (determinant eigenvalue)
complete_reduced_system.eq2: div_B(w grad v) = 0,  v -> +-infty at alternating rods  (ratio harmonic eq.)
complete_reduced_system.eq6: Unit closure: dp/dr -> 1 (or dq/dr -> 1) at each rod, primitive
